About
Teaching Faculty
The college is supported by a team of highly qualified, experienced, and dedicated teaching faculty who bring academic excellence and practical expertise to every department. Each faculty member is committed to delivering quality education through innovative teaching methods, hands-on training, and continuous mentoring. Their strong academic background, research experience, and field-level exposure help students gain in-depth subject knowledge and practical understanding.
Faculty members regularly participate in seminars, workshops, and professional development programmes to stay updated with the latest advancements in agriculture. They guide students in laboratory work, field training, research projects, and extension activities. The teaching team plays a vital role in shaping competent agricultural professionals with strong values, discipline, and scientific thinking.
Non-Teaching Staff
The non-teaching staff form the backbone of the institution by ensuring smooth administrative operations and providing essential support services to students and faculty. They assist in admissions, examination processes, accounts, documentation, and campus maintenance with efficiency and dedication. Laboratory assistants, field supervisors, office staff, technicians, and maintenance personnel work collectively to maintain a well-organised academic environment.
Their commitment ensures that classrooms, laboratories, farm units, and administrative sections function without interruption. The non-teaching team plays a key role in creating a supportive, safe, and student-friendly campus atmosphere. Their professionalism, discipline, and service-oriented approach contribute significantly to the overall success of the institution.
